name: ring finger protein 43

function.text: RNF43 encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RNF43. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin-protein transferase activity and ubiquitin protein ligase activity. It participates in protein ubiquitination and stem cell proliferation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to sessile serrated polyposis cancer syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastric adenocarcinoma; Mucinous carcinoma of ovary; Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
